Description: Healing through the body. Gentle touch, movement, and body awareness help release what the body has held since the womb, birth, and early life.
Healing through connection. Closeness between parent and baby, before and after birth, is where bonding grows and repair happens.
Healing through voice and music. Singing, chanting, toning, and music calm the nervous system and draw parent and baby together.
Healing through stillness and inner attention. Meditation, intention, and spiritual practice make space to clear and honor what the womb holds.
Healing through the body's energy. Tapping on acupressure points, imagery, and muscle feedback ease emotional charge and restore balance.
Healing through a relaxed, focused state of mind. In this state a person can reach early memories, even from the womb or birth, and meet them with new understanding and care.
Healing through the way the mind stores memory. A structured process helps disturbing memories, including birth experiences, lose their charge.
